import 'package:project/else_if.dart';
import 'package:test/test.dart';

void main() {
  // The second condition is false every time: no `else if` block ever runs.
  test('a false, b false', () {
    expect(elseIfNeverTrue(false, false), 3);
    expect(elseIfNoElse(false, false), 3);
    expect(elseIfWithCall(false, false), 3);
  });
}
